text:
maria.g: Quick sync — MerchantLane SI onboarding + co-sell rules before we go to marketplace? TL;DR: MerchantLane wants a joint launch + managed services listing. Need crisp rules for lead intake, account ownership, revenue split, and announcement approvals. Who owns mapping + partner play doc?

toml: I talked with their BD yesterday. They expect two SKUs: HW bundle (resale) and integration services. Marketplace listing will only show the HW bundle initially.

kevin_s: Note — for regulated customers MerchantLane expects direct sales (not marketplace). We should codify exceptions so Marketplace leads don't disappear into the field without Redwood visibility.

maria.g: @claire_r can you draft a one-pager intake form + routing rules? My proposal: marketplace leads -> marketplace queue (PartnerOps), field/enterprise -> MerchantLane SDR/AE, but Redwood keeps AE priority on existing accounts. ok?

claire_r: I can do that. q: do we use the standard SFDC "Partner" picklist or add partner_level + partner_handshake boolean? prefer structured fields to avoid manual overrides.

sam: Legal heads-up: joint announcement needs 14-day review and a logo usage license. Also confirm who signs MSAs vs SOWs. MerchantLane prefers to own implementation SOWs.

kevin_s: Draft mapping suggestion (simple rules):
```
account_pattern,lead_source,owner
existing_account,redwood_ae
partner_sourced,merchantlane_ae
marketplace_listing,partnerops_queue
regulated_vertical,merchantlane_direct
```
Let's make that machine-readable in SFDC automation.

maria.g: Adding cascade rules: if a Redwood AE is active on an existing account, Redwood retains primary handle and MerchantLane gets delivery credit. If the lead is captured via marketplace checkout and no prior Redwood contact -> PartnerOps qualifies then route to MerchantLane.

partners-bot: :calendar: Reminder: draft co-marketing assets due in 10 days. Create a PR in /marketing/partners with copy + logo files. (auto-checklist created)

toml: For rollout cadence — suggest soft launch to 3 pilot customers (joint demos) before marketplace public listing. MerchantLane has 2 pilots ready.

claire_r: I'll build the intake form template and SFDC flow today. Will add fields: partner_source, partner_level, partner_handshake, announcement_consent.

sam: Legal will prep a 1-page joint announcement agreement. Also need to decide on revenue split reporting cadence — monthly preferred.

kevin_s: Operational ask: add a tag "merchantlane_exempt" to SFDC when compliance customers are flagged so that automation routes them to MerchantLane Direct.

maria.g: Good. Next steps:
- @claire_r create draft intake + SFDC flow (ETA 48h)
- @sam finalizes announcement template (ETA 5 business days)
- @toml coordinate pilot demos and schedule 3 joint sessions (ETA 2 weeks)
- @kevin_s and I will draft PartnerOps handoff SOP + rate card mapping (ETA 4 days)

maria.g: If no objections I'll lock this as the initial play and circulate for exec sign-off tomorrow. :white_check_mark:

kevin_s: 44d

claire_r: on it.

sam: 44d will start legal draft.

partners-bot: :white_check_mark: Action items recorded: intake-draft (claire_r), legal-announcement (sam), pilot-schedule (toml), partnerops-sop (kevin_s).
